ios.NSCameraUsageDescription: pepfit uses the camera to scan food barcodes and QR codes, and for your workout photo.
ios.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: pepfit opens your gallery so you can pick your workout photo.
ios.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: pepfit never records sound: the camera is only used for barcodes, QR codes and photos.
ios.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: pepfit uses your location to track your outdoor workouts (distance, pace, map), even with the screen locked, and to find gyms around you.
ios.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: pepfit uses your location during your outdoor workouts to measure distance and pace, even with the screen locked. Nothing is tracked outside a workout.
ios.NSLocationAlwaysUsageDescription: pepfit uses your location during your outdoor workouts to measure distance and pace, even with the screen locked. Nothing is tracked outside a workout.
ios.NSMotionUsageDescription: pepfit uses your iPhone's barometer to measure the elevation gain of your outdoor workouts.
ios.NSBluetoothAlwaysUsageDescription: pepfit connects to your heart rate strap or Whoop to show your heart rate during your workout, even with the screen locked.
ios.NSHealthShareUsageDescription: pepfit reads your weight, body composition, steps, sleep, heart rate, workouts and cycle from Health to compute your gauges. Nothing is used for advertising.
ios.NSHealthUpdateUsageDescription: pepfit saves your workouts to Health (duration, calories, distance) so your other apps can see them.
ios.NSCalendarsUsageDescription: pepfit reads your calendar to fit your workouts around your appointments, and adds the workouts you choose.
ios.NSCalendarsFullAccessUsageDescription: pepfit reads your calendar to fit your workouts around your appointments, and adds the workouts you choose.
ios.NSRemindersUsageDescription: pepfit neither reads nor writes your reminders: only your calendar is used.
ios.NSRemindersFullAccessUsageDescription: pepfit neither reads nor writes your reminders: only your calendar is used.
ios.NSFaceIDUsageDescription: pepfit uses Face ID to lock the app and protect your data.
